rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for an ordinary building balcony.

example.english: I can dry clothes on the balcony of my flat.
example.traditional: 我間屋個露台可以曬衫。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaan1 uk1 go3 lou6 toi4 ho2 ji5 saai3 saam1

rows.note: Use this only for a traditional covered veranda or street-level arcade, rather than an ordinary projecting balcony.

example.english: When it rains, everyone shelters from the rain under the balcony.
example.traditional: 落雨嗰陣，大家喺騎樓底避雨。
example.jyutping: lok6 jyu5 go2 zan6 daai6 gaa1 hai2 ke4 lau2 dai2 bei6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this specifically for the upper-tier or balcony section of a theatre.

example.english: We bought balcony seats to watch the opera.
example.traditional: 我哋買咗樓座嘅飛睇歌劇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 lau4 zo6 ge3 fei1 tai2 go1 kek6
